summary.name: PPSSPP
summary.one_liner: PPSSPP is a free, open source PSP emulator that runs PlayStation Portable games in HD on PCs, Android phones and other devices.
use_cases: Playing PSP games in full HD on a PC
Running PSP games on an Android phone
Upscaling PSP textures for sharper graphics
Using a game controller or keyboard with PSP games
Transferring saves from a real PSP to an emulator
summary.what_it_does: PPSSPP runs PSP games on PCs and Android phones at full HD resolution or higher. It can upscale textures and apply post-processing shaders to adjust color, brightness and other effects. Users can save and restore game state at any time, customize on-screen touch controls, or use an external controller or keyboard. Graphics options include anisotropic filtering and texture scaling, and saves can be transferred from a real PSP.
notable: Renders PSP games in HD or higher resolutions
Licensed under GPL 2.0 (or later) with public source on GitHub
Can import saves from a real PSP
caveats: Compatibility varies by game; the page says it is steadily increasing but does not promise full support
